logline: The title page, drawn before page one: the masthead over the series' one image, with nobody in it. It letters the title, the subtitle and the tagline. No numeral, no title. The card's name is the thing.

panels.composition: A motel nightstand filling the page, its one drawer open an inch on darkness, the title lettered in brush capitals on the drawer's front with the brass pull as the O of DRAWER, a Gideon's edge and a pen just visible inside, the lamp above switched off, one spot tone on the pull.
